waves.name: PR400_PLAYER_PRESENTATION_READ_FOUNDATION
waves.purpose: Current-master authenticated Player Presentation read route and B028/B030/A025 read/transport stack.
waves.required_action: Preserve the /api/player/presentation route and its read-only authority boundary.

waves.name: EQUIPMENT_SCHEMA_AND_LOADOUT_SERVICE
waves.why_ordered_here: B034 requires B033 canonical_slot schema. The slot schema is also duplicated by C023, so one canonical schema decision must precede commerce import.
waves.integration_strategy: Create a new current-master candidate; selectively import B033 migration/test and B034 service/test, then add an explicit future app.py cutover only under the Lane E writer.
waves.schema_prerequisite: equipment_canonical_slot_v1 code exists only in candidates; production migration not executed.
waves.required_owner_gate: GO_MERGE for the current-master equipment candidate; separate schema/production migration gate later.

waves.name: ACQUISITION_RESULT_AND_PRODUCER_ADAPTER_FOUNDATION
waves.why_ordered_here: Future Shop and Monster/Quest producers need one canonical result/lineage boundary before route wiring. D020 has no new migration in its exact commit.
waves.integration_strategy: Selective import D018/D019/D020 modules and tests on e266; reconcile D021 docs; do not wire producers in app.py in parallel.
waves.schema_prerequisite: No new database schema is introduced by exact D020; existing D5 lineage authorities remain prerequisites where a producer is later activated.
waves.required_owner_gate: GO_MERGE for a current-master acquisition candidate; no Production migration implied.

waves.name: COMMERCE_CORE_SELECTIVE_IMPORT
waves.why_ordered_here: Commerce needs the equipment slot authority decision and should converge on the acquisition result boundary before a Shop route is wired.
waves.integration_strategy: Selectively import C019/C020/C021/C023 commerce modules, coin_purchase_operations_v1, tests, and docs. Do not import the duplicate f3ee equipment migration/test when Wave 1 already owns the canonical slot schema.
waves.schema_prerequisite: coin_purchase_operations_v1 code is candidate-only; canonical_slot migration must have one owner; neither is Production migrated.
waves.required_owner_gate: GO_MERGE for the reconciled commerce candidate; separate production migration and revenue/feature gates remain.

waves.name: WORLD_MONSTER_BATTLEFIELD_BOSS_BOUNDARY
waves.why_ordered_here: The boundary adapter is independent of Player Presentation and must remain separate from Lord and generic World progression. F015 adds a new milestone schema and is not an F014 Git descendant.
waves.integration_strategy: Current-master selective import F014 boundary/adapter modules and tests. Reconcile F015 separately only after its Owner status and milestone storage decision are closed.
waves.schema_prerequisite: F014 has no schema; F015's world_battlefield_boss_milestone_v1 is candidate-only and not implied by F014.
waves.required_owner_gate: GO_MERGE for F014 current-master candidate; separate gate for F015 milestone storage.
post_merge_verification: no generic selector or Player Presentation authority leakage

waves.name: PLAYER_PRESENTATION_FRONTEND_ADOPTION
candidate_inputs: A028 active branch when an implementation commit is available
A027 documentation as reconciled evidence only
waves.why_ordered_here: PR400 already provides the backend/read foundation. The frontend should consume the current API contract after backend equipment and authority changes stabilize.
waves.integration_strategy: Use the A028 branch created from e266; do not use old A027 documentation as an implementation base. No concurrent hero.html writer.
waves.schema_prerequisite: None for read adoption; equipment display must honor invalid-state/provenance contracts.
waves.required_owner_gate: GO_MERGE for the A028 candidate after responsive/device acceptance.

waves.name: SINGLE_OWNER_APP_PY_CUTOVERS_AND_COMBINED_ACCEPTANCE
candidate_inputs: future World/Boss route or event binding
waves.why_ordered_here: The accepted foundations are pure modules/docs and do not modify app.py. Their public route/event wiring is the highest collision surface and must be reconciled by one Lane E executor.
waves.integration_strategy: One fresh e266-or-later integration worktree, one app.py owner, one serial sequence. Run a boundary test after each route cutover and combined acceptance last.
waves.schema_prerequisite: Each route cutover waits for its domain schema/evidence gate; no Production migration is part of this plan.
waves.required_owner_gate: New GO_MERGE for each reviewed integration candidate; GO_DEPLOY and feature enable remain separate.

stale_master_policy.docs_only_recon: May remain reviewable when findings are source-stable and no overlapping files changed, but the final report must state the new current master and any changed-domain reconciliation.
stale_master_policy.runtime_implementation: Must prove current origin/master is an ancestor, or produce a new current-master integration candidate before GO_MERGE readiness. Being behind is not itself a rejection; silently treating it as current is prohibited.
stale_master_policy.frontend_implementation: Must use the current Player Presentation API contract and a current-master-based candidate; no concurrent hero.html writer.
stale_master_policy.schema_candidate: Schema code existence, schema merge, Production migration, and feature enable are separate gates.

next_app_py_policy: Serial current-master cutover only; pure modules, tests, migrations, contracts, and docs may be prepared independently, but overlapping app.py edits are forbidden.
production_policy: E029 performs no Production query, schema migration, feature enable, deploy, or master merge.
